conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division, Agent Lewis speaking. Am I reaching Mr. Patel, owner of Patel Tech Consulting?
Yes, this is him. Is something wrong?
Mr. Patel, our records show critical discrepancies regarding your federal tax filings, specifically unreported 1099 forms and missing payroll tax submissions. This is an urgent IRS compliance matter.
I always file my taxes. What is missing? I don't understand.

According to our database, you failed to report contractor payments for at least two tax periods. This constitutes a serious federal violation and triggers immediate penalties unless resolved right now.
I'm sorry, I didn't know. I work alone mostly. Will this affect my work visa?

I strongly advise you don't ignore this. Unresolved payroll tax violations can lead to business license revocation, asset freezes, and may be reported to immigration authorities. I need to confirm your identity and business details to proceed. Please verify your business EIN and home address.
My EIN is 88-1234567 and my address is 42 Maple Drive, Suite 5. Please, I don't want trouble.

Thank you for confirming. Let me check your compliance profile. Hold on... Mr. Patel, it appears you now face an immediate IRS penalty of $7,200. If this is not resolved today, further action, such as a federal audit or asset seizure, will be triggered.
I don't have that much money. What can I do?

Listen carefully. The only way to halt enforcement is to make an IRS-certified payment today. We can process this via direct bank wire, certified crypto transfer, or through federally authorized prepaid cards. Which method can you access immediately?
I don't understand. I have my bank account, but I've never paid taxes with gift cards.

This is not standard, but due to the urgency and your non-compliance status, you are being offered a hardship resolution. You must go to your nearest store and purchase $7,200 in Apple or Target gift cards. Do not hang up. You must stay on the line at all times for verification.
I feel very nervous. Are you sure this is what I have to do?

Mr. Patel, if you hesitate, the IRS will initiate a formal criminal complaint, which could jeopardize your residency status. I do not want that for you. Take your phone, go directly to the store, and tell me when you arrive. Do not inform anyone of this call or your account may be flagged for further investigation.
Okay, I will go now. It will take about fifteen minutes.
Understood. Remain on the line and keep me updated. When you purchase the cards, do not let the cashier know they are for tax settlement. If you tell anyone, enforcement action could escalate.
I'm almost at the store. What exactly do I need to buy?
Purchase Apple or Target gift cards totaling $7,200. They must be in increments of $500 or $1000. Once you have the cards, read me the redemption codes on the back for immediate IRS processing.
I got the cards. What do I do now?
Read me each card number and the PIN code clearly. This is the only way to stop the investigation and protect your business and immigration status.
Okay, I have one here: 4859 1234 5678 9012, PIN 3456.
Good. Continue with the next code. We need all codes to process the payment in full. Once this is done, you will receive a compliance confirmation and no further action will be taken against you.
